questions.q: Is there an SD card slot on the front of the hopper?
Does a coin feeder sit on top of the hopper?

members.name: SMART Hopper 4
members.features: Has an SD card slot on the front. The configuration button is pressed and held for 5 seconds and switches between SSP and CC2 only. If a coin feeder sits on top of the hopper, it is a SMART Hopper 4 fitted as a SMART Coin System.

members.name: SMART Hopper 3
members.features: No SD card slot on the front. The configuration button cycles between SSP, CC2 and CC1.

questions.q: Are there two hoppers in it, side by side?
Is the validator fitted to a payout module that stores notes and pays them out?

members.name: NV200
members.features: The note validator on its own, with no payout module.

members.name: SMART Payout
members.features: An NV200 fitted to a payout module, which stores notes and pays them out.

members.name: NV200 Spectral
members.features: The NV200 Spectral note validator on its own, with no payout module.

members.name: Spectral Payout
members.features: An NV200 Spectral fitted to a payout module.

questions.q: Is a note float (a round drum that stores notes) fitted on top?
Is a multi-note float fitted on top?

members.name: NV9USB+
members.features: The NV9USB+ note validator on its own.

members.name: NV9 Spectral
members.features: The NV9 Spectral note validator on its own.

members.name: NV11
members.features: An NV9USB+ with a note float recycler fitted on top.

members.name: NV11 Spectral
members.features: An NV9 Spectral with a note float recycler fitted on top.

members.name: NV22 Spectral
members.features: An NV9 Spectral with a multi-note float fitted on top. The multi-note float fits only the NV9 Spectral.
